# DraftPro Studio — AI-CAD Drafting & Interactive 3D Floor Plan Service

> DraftPro Studio converts hand sketches, PDFs, and legacy floor plans into standardized AutoCAD DWG/DXF construction drawings, A3 PDF sets, and standalone single-file 3D interactive browser walkthroughs within 48–72 hours.

## Core Offerings & Fixed Pricing
- **Single Sheet CAD Redraw**: $120 USD / NT$3,500 TWD — Hand sketch, PDF, or scan converted to layered AutoCAD 2018+ DWG + A3 PDF in 48 hours (includes 2 revisions).
- **2D CAD + Interactive 3D Web Floor Plan Pack**: $300 USD / NT$9,800 TWD — Dimensioned 2D floor plan DWG/DXF plus a zero-install, single-file HTML 3D walkthrough with toggleable furniture, flooring, ceiling, and MEP (electrical & plumbing) layers, plus automated quantity takeoff CSV in 72 hours (includes 3 revisions).
- **Studio Monthly Retainer**: $890 USD / NT$28,000 TWD per month — Up to 10 CAD construction sheets + 2 interactive 3D web presentations per month with 24-hour priority turnaround.

## Technical & Architectural QA Standards
- Accurate structural bearing walls (240mm / 200mm) and interior partitions (120mm).
- Code-compliant door swings, window sills/heads, and clear passage widths (>= 1,800mm main circulation).
- Automated spatial collision and electrical/plumbing (MEP) clearance verification (0 errors, 0 warnings).
- Supports Taiwan Traditional Chinese (坪 / mm) and International English (sq ft / m²).
